subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: Should plugin-owned subagent runs get a generic tool-scoping option, and should memory-core Dream Diary use a prose-only or mutation-denied profile?
rationale: The bug is clear from source, but the durable fix is an SDK/runtime contract decision rather than a local prompt change inside memory-core.

options.title: Add generic subagent tool scoping
options.body: Extend the plugin subagent runtime and gateway agent path with a typed tool policy, then have memory-core opt the Dream Diary lane into a prose-only or mutation-denied profile.

options.title: Patch memory-core locally
options.body: Add a memory-core-specific denylist or stronger prompt without giving other plugin subagents the same typed safety surface.

options.title: Accept current fallback behavior
options.body: Leave the generic tool surface in place because invalid patches are rejected and the diary fallback succeeds, accepting recurring log noise and unnecessary mutation-tool exposure.

recommendation.title: Add generic subagent tool scoping
recommendation.body: Extend the plugin subagent runtime and gateway agent path with a typed tool policy, then have memory-core opt the Dream Diary lane into a prose-only or mutation-denied profile.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway/plugin runtime contracts and tool-safety defaults, where the history points most strongly to this owner route.
